request.body:
Parent #56 (C15), related #337 (finding F4 of report PR #357), umbrella #26. Base `codex/existence-monograph` @ `97f806c7`; Lean pin `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`.

**Task type:** explain (prove in detail; small).

**Interface.** Two C15 chapters state the same elementary clock-cap facts as outstanding inputs:
- `trace-scribe-producer.tex`, third clause of `eq:ex-lattice-scribe-clock-inputs`: eventually `0 <= log b_i <= (log hat-beta_{j_i})^48`, where `b_i` is the zoom factor and `j_i` the frame level of the i-th chart (#357 F4; part-B ledger row E-clock, "producer unidentified").
- `trace-small-means.tex` (paragraph before `lem:ex-trace-small-means`): "the cap tiltcap(j) has a zero-rate ticket", listed among the outstanding inputs on the selected schedule. `tiltcap` is used there and in `trace-mission-price.tex` (`1 <= b_i <= tiltcap(j_i)`) but is not defined in the manuscript.

**Source (read textually).** `YM.Calendar.monitor` (`YM/RG/History.lean`), `YM.Next.Rank.Station.mag`, `YM.Next.Rank.Perch.y`, `YM.Trace.Terrace.tilt_cap`, `YM.Trace.Terrace.Ticket`, `YM.Trace.Terrace.titles` (`Terrace/Fund.lean`), `YM.Trace.Terrace.tiltP` (`Terrace/Cabin.lean`), `YM.Trace.Terrace.b_zoom`, `grow_big` (`Terrace/SkyEar.lean`), `TimberSky.high` (`Prom/Zoom/Boats.lean`), and their use in `YM.Trace.Over.zoom_BQ` (`Chart/Orr.lean`). These are proved in the source from the clock definitions alone; no further analytic input appears to be needed.

**Owned outputs.**
- New `manuscript/existence/trace-clock-cap.tex` (definition of the monitor and tilt cap, the zero-rate ticket lemma, and the log-zoom bound under the chart receipt `1 <= b_i <= tiltcap(j_i)`), with one `\input` line in `manuscript/existence.tex`.
- Citation-only edits: the third clause of `eq:ex-lattice-scribe-clock-inputs` in `trace-scribe-producer.tex`, and the tilt-cap ticket sentence in `trace-small-means.tex`. No other change to those chapters.
- New evidence/correspondence note `blueprint/units/YM-000026/trace-clock-cap-evidence.md`.
Not included: the summit ticket `hat-beta_{summit(j)} <= 2 hat-beta_j` (`YM.Trace.Terrace.bond`, uses `PostT`), the two ratio limits of the clock inputs, `unit.json` (coordinator), ledgers, `Lean/`.

**Prerequisites.** None beyond the existing clock definitions (`hat-beta_j = bar-beta + kappa log a_j^{-1}`, `hat-beta_j > 1`, `hat-beta_j -> infinity`).

**Acceptance.** Detailed proofs; exact quantifiers; correspondence to the declarations above recorded in the evidence note; checker and tests pass; full `existence.tex` builds and the new pages are inspected; independent mathematics and Lean-correspondence review by a different account.
